what: يصمم أدوات MCP والدوال بحيث يعرف النموذج متى يستدعيها وماذا يمرر وكيف يتعافى من الخطأ. — Designs MCP and function tools so the model knows when to call them, what to pass and how to recover from errors.
when: تصميم أداة MCP، أدوات للوكيل، function calling / MCP tool design, agent tools, function calling
how: 1) Names, descriptions, parameter names and error text are written for machine comprehension; they are the only orchestration layer, nothing enforces call order. 2) Description says when to call and when not to. 3) Parameters: few, typed, enums over free strings, sensible defaults. 4) Results: compact, stable shape, with the next useful identifiers. 5) Errors carry recovery guidance the agent can act on, not stack traces. 6) Design for non-deterministic chaining: every tool must be safe to call out of order.

name_ar: حدود الثقة في الأدوات: الأسرار تُحقن والصلاحيات في الكود
name_en: Tool trust boundary: injected secrets, permissions in code
what: يحمي الأدوات من حقن الأوامر: لا مفاتيح ظاهرة للنموذج، وفحص الصلاحية للفعل والهدف يتم في الكود قبل التنفيذ. — Hardens tools against prompt injection: no model-visible keys, and permission checks for action and target run in code before execution.
when: أمان أداة الوكيل، حماية المفاتيح، prompt injection / tool security, secret injection, prompt injection defence
how: 1) Name the principal the tool acts as and where its identity comes from. 2) Credentials are resolved server-side at call time, never a parameter; fix the host in config so a key cannot be sent elsewhere. 3) Check permission in code for both the action and the specific target, before the operation. 4) Declare and pre-check scopes per tool. 5) Fix the boundary: tenant, root path, allowed hosts, quotas. 6) Log every call with redacted parameters. 7) Prompts express intent; only code enforces rules.

name_ar: منع رفع الأسرار عند الالتزام
name_en: Block secrets at commit time
what: يفحص ما سيُلتزم به قبل الرفع بماسح أسرار، لأن المفتاح بعد الدفع لا يُحذف بل يُدوّر. — Scans what is about to be committed with a secret scanner, because once pushed a key cannot be deleted, only rotated.
when: منع تسريب المفاتيح، فحص الأسرار قبل commit / prevent committing secrets, pre-commit secret scan
how: 1) A hook file is not proof: many pre-commit hooks only format and exit 0; check that one actually scans. 2) Scan staged content directly with a scanner in staged mode and with redaction so the finding does not print the secret into logs or transcripts. 3) Staged mode ignores untracked files: check env-like files and .gitignore before a future 'add -A'. 4) Install repo-locally through a versioned pre-commit config; committing the config protects nobody until each clone installs it. 5) After a leak, rotate the key; deleting the line is not containment.

what: يراجع فرقاً أو PR بحثاً عن ثغرات واثقة فقط، ويحوّل طلب تدقيق المستودع كاملاً إلى منهج مختلف. — Reviews a diff or PR for confident vulnerabilities only, and switches method when asked to audit a whole codebase.

name_ar: التحقق من السلوك لا من التفاصيل الداخلية، بأوامر المستودع نفسه
name_en: Behaviour-level assertions per layer, with the repo's own commands
what: يكتب تحققات تشبه طريقة استخدام البرنامج فعلاً في كل طبقة، ويكتشف أوامر المستودع قبل أي شيء؛ دورة الأحمر والأخضر نفسها في CODE-08. — Asserts only what each layer's user can observe and discovers the repository's own commands first; the red-green loop itself is CODE-08.
when: الاختبارات تنكسر عند إعادة الهيكلة، ماذا أتحقق منه / brittle tests, what to assert, tests break on refactor
how: 1) Principle: the closer a check is to how the software is used, the more confidence it gives. 2) Assert only on what the user of that layer can observe: return values, errors and public types for a library; status and body for an API; visible text and roles for a UI; never private helpers. 3) Checks bound to internals fail on harmless refactors and stay green on real breakage. 4) For a bug, reproduce it first, then fix (prove-it); the red-green-refactor loop is CODE-08. 5) Discover the stack before writing anything: build files, checked-in wrappers (./gradlew, make), framework, neighbouring conventions and the commands CI runs; run the focused command in the loop and the full suite before finishing; never assume 'npm test'.

name_ar: أداء الويب: الكمون قبل عرض النطاق
name_en: Web performance: latency before bandwidth
what: يحسّن سرعة الموقع بتقليل الرحلات ذهاباً وإياباً، لأن الكمون لا عرض النطاق هو عنق الزجاجة غالباً. — Speeds up a site by cutting round trips, because latency rather than bandwidth is usually the bottleneck.
when: الموقع بطيء، تحسين السرعة، Core Web Vitals / slow website, web performance, round trips
how: 1) Every new connection pays DNS, TCP handshake (1 RTT) and TLS before data; reuse connections, preconnect to critical origins, use HTTP/2 or 3. 2) Distance is physics (about 28 ms one way New York-London), so move content closer (CDN, edge cache). 3) Cut requests and bytes on the critical path; inline or preload the critical CSS and fonts. 4) Then fix rendering cost: layout, paint, raster and compositing work. 5) Judge by field metrics (LCP, INP, CLS) not only lab scores.

name_ar: jq: نموذج المرشّح لتدفق JSON
name_en: jq filter mental model for JSON streams
what: يعالج JSON من سطر الأوامر بفهم أن برنامج jq مرشّح يحوّل تدفق قيم إلى تدفق قيم. — Processes JSON on the command line by treating a jq program as a filter from a stream of values to a stream of values.
when: استخراج من JSON، فلترة JSON في الطرفية / filter JSON, jq query, extract fields
how: 1) A filter takes one JSON value and emits zero, one or many; '.' is identity, '.[]' emits each element, 'select' can emit nothing. 2) Pipe filters with '|' like a shell. 3) It is pure: assignment returns a modified copy. 4) It runs once per input value; use -s to slurp a stream into one array, -r for raw strings, -c for one line per value. 5) Deterministic stdin to stdout, ideal for CI and agents.
